name: Sausage Sizzle
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: About five Australian-style thin sausages ("snags") per person (thick sausages on special occasions)
Loaves of sliced sandwich bread (enough for one slice per sausage)
Sliced onions, with a little oil or butter (optional)

steps: Grill the sausages (eucalyptus wood fire is best) until the skins are partially black.
Grill the sliced onions, if desired.
Wrap each sausage in a slice of bread, running the sausage diagonally along the bread.
Add grilled onions and tomato sauce to taste.
